prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a busy library reading room scene. On the far left, a tall bookshelf stands filled with colorful spines. Next to the bookshelf sits a woman in a blue dress on a wooden chair. She is looking at an open book resting on her lap. A small orange cat sleeps peacefully next to her feet. In the center foreground, a man in a red scarf points at a map spread across a large table. Beside him, a child in a yellow hat looks at the same map with wide eyes. The man in the red scarf is handing a pencil to the child in the yellow hat. Behind them, a librarian with glasses stands near a counter. She is pointing at a computer screen for a student in a green hoodie who is sitting on a stool. To the right of the central table, an elderly man with a cane leans against a pillar. He is looking at a clock hanging high on the wall. Near the window on the right, a young woman in a pink sweater types on a laptop. A potted plant sits next to her desk. In the background, a security guard in a uniform walks past a row of study cubicles. He is looking at a tablet in his hand. A brown dog lies under the central table, chewing on a toy. There is no sunlight streaming through the windows. There is no coffee cup on any surface.
